package.name: chest_display
package.description: OLAF chest-display app (Epic 8) — standalone pygame/KMSDRM portrait dashboard on the 4.3" DSI chest panel: animated anatomical heart + three log panels, with a view-manager for full-screen takeover. The heart is driven by the expression engine via a delegating adapter (Story 8.4); 8.1 stands up the app, layout, and view-manager. See docs/planning-artifacts/sprint-change-proposal-2026-06-03.md.
